title: The Pixel less Pack (block edition)
description: This Pack Changes Textures to remove the pixels. Not every block currently available. the pack is Reccomended for 1.21.8 or 1.21.7.
body:
The Point Of this pack is to give players a feel for how minecraft would be with no pixels. it is digitally hand drawn by me. The reason I made it was so I could play minecraft with a new feel!

How To Install: 

1. download the recource pack
2. open the zip file
3. put the file in your recource pack folder
4. Play minecraft with the pack installed!

Reccomended Versions: 1.21.7 - 1.21.8
